tcct.author: Clark Kimberling
tcct.notes: Foundational monograph establishing the formal theory of triangle centers, central lines, central triangles, and the initial 400 centers of the ETC.

kimberling-1994.author: Clark Kimberling
kimberling-1994.work: Central Points and Central Lines in the Plane of a Triangle
kimberling-1994.notes: Landmark paper introducing the systematic indexing of triangle centers X(n) and central lines L(n).

kimberling-2002-fg.author: Clark Kimberling
kimberling-2002-fg.notes: Introduces the Hebrew-letter conjugacies (aleph, beth, gimel, daleth, he, waw, zayin) and their cubic loci.

gibert-ctc.author: Bernard Gibert
gibert-ctc.notes: Comprehensive catalog of pivotal, isogonal, isotomic, and general curves in the plane of a triangle, referenced via K-indices across the ETC.

forum-geometricorum.author: Paul Yiu (Ed.)
forum-geometricorum.notes: Peer-reviewed journal dedicated to classical Euclidean and modern triangle geometry.

hyacinthos.author: Antreas P. Hatzipolakis (Founder)
hyacinthos.notes: The primary international research mailing list where thousands of triangle centers and theorems in the ETC were discovered and proved.

adgeom.author: Antreas P. Hatzipolakis (Founder)
adgeom.notes: Research groups succeeding Hyacinthos as primary sources for new configurations and centers in the ETC.

mathworld.author: Eric W. Weisstein
mathworld.notes: Comprehensive online mathematical encyclopedia with interactive illustrations and cross-references for Kimberling centers.

court-1952.author: Nathan Altshiller-Court
court-1952.work: College Geometry: An Introduction to the Modern Geometry of the Triangle and the Circle
court-1952.notes: Classic treatise on synthetic triangle geometry cited throughout the ETC for historical priority and constructions.

johnson-1929.author: Roger A. Johnson
johnson-1929.notes: Standard reference on the geometry of the triangle, Miquel and Johnson circles, Brocard geometry, and Tucker circles.

rabinowitz-2021.author: Stanley Rabinowitz
rabinowitz-2021.work: Location of Triangle Centers Relative to the Incircle and Circumcircle
rabinowitz-2021.locus: International Journal of Computer Discovered Mathematics (IJCDM) 6 (2021)
rabinowitz-2021.notes: Systematic classification of which triangle centers lie strictly inside, on, or outside the incircle and circumcircle.
